name: documind-rag-benchmark-v2
description: Verified 110-question RAG benchmark across vendor, security, HR, retention, cloud, support, procurement, roadmap, facilities, and API policy documents.

pages: Northwind Vendor Agreement. Northwind invoices are due net 45 days from the invoice date. Late balances accrue a 1.5 percent monthly fee. Invoices must be sent to ap@northwind.example.

The Northwind agreement has an initial term of 24 months. It renews for successive 12 month periods unless either party gives 90 days written notice before renewal. Renewal notices must be sent to the legal team.

Northwind may be terminated for convenience with 30 days written notice. A material breach requires a 15 day written cure period before termination. Termination notices must reference the agreement date.

Confidentiality obligations survive for 5 years after termination. Northwind must return or destroy confidential data within 30 days after termination. A written certification of destruction is required.
Northwind liability is capped at $500,000 per claim. The agreement is governed by Delaware law. Disputes must be filed in New Castle County, Delaware.
Information Security Policy. Production and administrative access requires multi-factor authentication. Accounts lock after five failed login attempts. Passwords must contain at least 16 characters.
Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256. Data in transit must use TLS 1.3. Backups are retained for 35 days and tested monthly.
Security incidents must be reported to the security team within one hour. A security incident postmortem is due within 5 business days. The security on-call pager is available around the clock.
Access reviews occur quarterly. Access for terminated employees is removed within 24 hours. Privileged access is recertified annually.
Security logs are retained for 12 months. Critical vulnerabilities must be patched within 7 days. An external penetration test is performed annually.
Employee Handbook. Full-time employees receive 20 days of paid time off each year. Employees may carry over 5 unused PTO days. PTO requests longer than 3 days need two weeks advance notice.
Employees may work remotely 3 days per week. Core collaboration hours are 10am to 3pm local time. Remote employees receive a $75 monthly internet stipend.
Expense reports are due within 30 days of purchase. Itemized receipts are required for expenses over $25. Approved reimbursements are paid within 10 business days.
Parental leave provides 16 weeks of paid leave. Employees receive 10 days of paid sick leave each year. Bereavement leave provides 5 days.
Harassment can be reported to HR or the ethics hotline. HR acknowledges reports within 2 business days. Retaliation against reporters is prohibited.

Data Retention Policy. Customer records are retained for 7 years after contract end. Deletion requests are completed within 30 days unless a legal hold applies. Support tickets are retained for 3 years.
Employee records are retained for 6 years after departure. Payroll records are retained for 7 years. Recruitment records are kept for 2 years.
Audit logs are retained for 13 months. Security logs are retained for 18 months. Access logs are retained for 12 months.
A legal hold suspends all deletion activity. Legal must be notified within 2 business days. Each legal hold is reviewed annually.
Data retention backup copies are kept for 45 days. Deleted data is purged from backups within 60 days. Backup restore tests run quarterly.
Cloud Architecture Standard. The primary region is us-east-1 and the disaster recovery region is eu-west-1. The recovery time objective is 4 hours. The recovery point objective is 15 minutes.
Autoscaling targets 65 percent CPU utilization. Each service runs between 3 and 30 instances. Scale-out cooldown is 3 minutes.
Prometheus collects metrics every 15 seconds. Alerts page the on-call engineer when the 5xx rate exceeds 2 percent for 5 minutes. Dashboards retain 30 days of data.
Production deployments occur Tuesday and Thursday from 9am to 11am ET. A canary receives 10 percent of traffic. Rollback completes within 5 minutes.
The PostgreSQL read replica is in ca-central-1. CloudFront caches content for 300 seconds. Vault rotates secrets every 90 days.
Customer Support Playbook. P1 tickets require a first response within 15 minutes. P2 tickets require a response within 1 hour. P3 tickets require a response within 4 hours.
A P1 incident is a complete outage affecting all users. A P2 incident is a major feature that is degraded. A P3 incident affects a single user.
Escalate to the support lead after 30 minutes without a response. The incident commander joins after 60 minutes. Executive notification occurs after 2 hours.
Customers may request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Manager approval is required for refunds over $500. Refunds are processed within 5 business days.
The public status page is updated within 30 minutes of a customer outage. Updates are posted hourly. A customer-outage postmortem is published within 3 business days.
Procurement Policy. Purchases under $5,000 require manager approval. Purchases from $5,000 to $50,000 require director approval. Purchases over $50,000 require VP and finance approval.
Three written quotes are required above $25,000. Two quotes are required from $10,000 to $25,000. A sole-source purchase requires a CFO waiver.
Vendor security reviews take 10 business days. Vendors must provide a W-9 tax form. Vendors must carry $2 million in liability insurance.
A purchase order is required above $2,000. Invoice matching is a three-way match. Standard vendor payment terms are net 30.
Employees may accept gifts valued up to $50. Cash gifts are prohibited. Gifts must be disclosed within 10 days.
Product Roadmap. Features release every two weeks. A hotfix can ship on any day. Code freeze begins 3 days before a release.
Q1 delivers single sign-on for enterprise customers. Q2 delivers audit log exports. The beta program starts in March.
The beta program accepts 25 customers. Each beta customer receives a 30-day evaluation. Feedback surveys are sent within 7 days.
Deprecated features receive 90 days notice. API v1 sunsets on June 30. A migration guide is published with every deprecation.
Product accessibility targets WCAG 2.2 AA. Spanish and German localization ships in Q3. Telemetry collection is opt-in.
Facilities Guide. The office is open from 7am to 7pm. Staff badges provide access 24/7. Visitors must sign in at reception.
Employee parking is on garage level 2. Parking costs $40 per month. Six EV chargers are available.
The emergency assembly point is the north lawn. Floor wardens guide evacuation. Fire drills occur every 6 months.
Conference rooms can be booked 30 days in advance. Reservations must be canceled 1 hour before use. Eight conference rooms are available.
Mailroom shipping cutoff is 2pm. Recycling bins are in every kitchen. Compost collection occurs on Fridays.
API Security Standard. OAuth access tokens expire after 60 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after 30 days. Applications must use least-privilege scopes.
API keys are limited to 100 requests per minute. Burst traffic may reach 200 requests. A 429 response includes Retry-After 60 seconds.
API keys must be rotated every 90 days. A compromised key must be revoked within 24 hours. Two active keys are allowed during rotation.
All API connections require TLS 1.2 or higher. Payloads over 1 MB are rejected. JSON requests are validated against a schema.
Webhooks are signed with HMAC-SHA256. Failed webhooks are retried five times over 30 minutes. API audit logs are retained for 12 months.
